sections.heading: Progress towards Apple 2030
sections.source_text:
Apple 2030 is our commitment to be carbon neutral for our entire carbon footprint. Our plan to decarbonise products is rigorous and focuses on transitioning to low‑carbon electricity, designing with recycled and low‑carbon materials, and prioritising lower-carbon ways of shipping products, like sea freight.
Materials
The 16‑inch MacBook Pro is made with 45% recycled content, 11 including:
100% recycled aluminium in the enclosure and thermal module stage
100% recycled cobalt and 95% recycled lithium in the battery
100% recycled copper in multiple printed circuit boards and thermal module components
100% recycled gold plating and tin solder in all Apple‑designed printed circuit boards
100% recycled rare earth elements in all magnets
80% or more recycled steel in the keyboard feature plate and speaker components

sections.heading: Energy
sections.source_text:
50% of manufacturing electricity for the 16‑inch MacBook Pro is sourced from low‑carbon electricity 17
ENERGY STAR® certified 13

sections.heading: Waste
sections.source_text: No established final assembly sites generate waste sent to landfill as part of Apple’s Zero Waste Program 18

sections.heading: Smarter chemistry 14
sections.source_text: All the materials used in Apple products, accessories and packaging are covered by the requirements of our Regulated Substances Specification (PDF) opens in new tab , which was one of the first in industry to restrict the use of key substances of concern. See the latest En­viron­men­tal Progress Report (PDF) opens in new tab to understand Apple’s recent efforts in phasing out these chemistries.
